text: The Interim General Manager, Economic Development and Culture, will give a presentation on the development of a Cultural District Plan for the City of Toronto to preserve and protect culture in the City. This presentation seeks to gain strategic feedback and advice from Committee members.

The Confronting Anti-Black Racism Advisory Committee: 1. Requested the Interim General Manager, Economic Development and Culture, to incorporate the Committee's feedback into the development of a cultural district plan for the City of Toronto.
